answer: Locks are recorded in ferrous, expire in mirror, and shale lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 160 aliases as a result needs 76 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 158 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
